story_context.i_want: to log in with email and password
story_context.so_that: I can securely access the village management system

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: As a village administrator, I want to log in with email and password, so that I can securely access the village management system. Acceptance criteria include creating a login page, integrating Appwrite authentication, validating form inputs, handling redirection, and managing state with Pinia.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: The system will use Appwrite's built-in email/password authentication. A Pinia store will manage session state, and a router guard will protect routes.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Implement a comprehensive role system. Enforce module-level and field-level permissions. Support multi-role assignment.

doc.title: UX/UI Specification
doc.snippet: The first-time setup wizard will guide the user through creating the initial admin account if no users exist in the system.

constraints.constraint: All Vue components must use the <script setup> syntax.
Pinia stores must follow the `*-store.js` naming convention.
All user-facing error messages must be handled by the `useErrorHandler` composable.
Authentication state must be managed exclusively through the Pinia store.

standards.standard: Manual testing is required for this foundational story. Verify all acceptance criteria, including conditional rendering, form validation, successful/failed API calls, and redirection.
Use the browser's developer tools to inspect network requests to Appwrite and to clear session storage/cookies to test session persistence and logout.

locations.location: No automated tests are required for this story. Manual verification is sufficient.

ideas.idea: Verify that the correct form (admin creation vs. login) is displayed based on whether users exist.
Test the admin creation form with valid and invalid data. Confirm successful creation and redirection.
Test the login form with correct and incorrect credentials. Test the 'Remember me' functionality.
Attempt to access a protected route (e.g., `/`) while unauthenticated and confirm redirection to the login page.
Verify that the logout button clears the session and redirects to the login page.
